sections.section_title: CSI-2 Host timer x configuration register (CSI_TIMxCFGR)
sections.text_helper: Section 40.9.8 "CSI-2 Host timer x configuration register (CSI_TIMxCFGR)" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2048.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x60 + 0x04 * x, (x = 0 to 3)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 24:0 COUNT[24:0]: Clock cycle counter
This register is used to specify how many clock cycles (clk_proc) the timer needs to count
from a SOF on the considered virtual channel, before triggering the associated interrupt flag
ifenabled in CSI_PRGITR. The interruption is generated if TIMxIE is set in CSI_IER0.
